info.name: Google Chrome Management App Details API

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

params.name: appId
params.description: The Chrome Web Store app ID.

items.docs: Retrieves specific information about a Chrome app or extension by its app ID. Returns metadata including name, description, permissions, icons, type, and store information.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

items.docs: Retrieves specific information about an Android app by its package name. Returns metadata for apps available on managed ChromeOS devices through Google Play.

params.name: customerId
params.description: Google Workspace customer ID. Use 'my_customer' to refer to the customer associated with the authenticated admin.

items.docs: Retrieves specific information about a web app. Returns metadata for progressive web apps or web links available to managed ChromeOS devices.
